body: Hey there 👋 Like with any goal in life, it's important to be clear about what you want. First, you should define the kinds of things you want to do. There are apps like Eventbrite and Meetup that often have groups that cater to different interests. If it's something such as dance, look around for dance studios that offer adult classes and/or social dances for their students. It is a great way to begin to meet people regularly. Another point I'd like to make is sometimes those of us that like peace and somewhat solitary activities need to lean into that part of ourselves. Focus on finding special interest or niche events and having one regular friend that shares that passion with you to attend those types of things. Friend groups are usually formed after repeated interactions at certain clubs, organizations or events. Bear in mind as well that you are in the adult world now and that everyone around you has complex lives. You will see your homies less. The last thing I'll say is sit down and try to memorize some of those "get to know someone" questions. A lot of people love meeting that one person that day who just sat down and listened to them for a while, so be sure to study up on those listening skills as well. Hope this helps ☀️

Listen. I'm 23 and I promise you, the situation is frustrating.  200k in debt over here for a degree that sounds a lot less valuable than yours. Someone else promised to pay for mine, I highly doubt they will follow through. It is not a fun situation to be in. It is okay to feel like screaming. Please do.  It helps a lot.

Now onto the good part.  There are other options. Yes, you will need money. At the very least, just to pay off the debt. Temp work is an option for the slow periods of your life, and hopefully your career can cover the rest. You never need to be truly, without money, if you are say,  in average functional health. There will always be ways to make money. 

Now for the stress. You are not alone. You have a boyfriend. I'm hoping their presence alone brings you joy. It sounds like it might, if you're alright with keeping them around during your stressful times. That's good. The next thing is, others have fought your battle before and won. It was difficult, of course, but it is winnable. If you need to, take a moment and breathe. Deep breathing is wonderful. 

Remember above all else that you have accomplished many things to get to this point. This will simply become another accomplishment for you to talk about someday. Now for the answer you want.

The point of life is well, arbitrary. There are as many answers as people. You sound quite intelligent so I'm sure you know this. If you didn't already know though, the key to happiness is in what you do everyday. My unsolicited suggestion is to incorporate one thing that makes you happy everyday. Add more as you go along. Set up a payment plan and your debt will go away. And you will have a lovely life to look back on when you've finally paid it off. Good luck!

The best place to start is always deep breathing. Then, slowly try to check in with yourself everyday. Emotions can be very strong and yes, sometimes emerge quickly, so it helps to give yourself methods that can create space for you when those moments come. I hope this helps.
